name: Job Applications Tracker
description:
Everybody knows how important it becomes to apply with a referral when you are seeking a job, but at the same time it becomes hard to exactly remember for which all roles you're waiting for a referral. This is the exact problem we try to resolve through this app.

The app comes with a beautiful UI that allows user to add just the relevant details for the job applications. You add the company name, job role, job url, and the status of the app. And the app decides how often you should be notified. You can add job application with following status -
• Waiting for Referral - You can add this status if you've asked for referrals but not yet received them. For such applications, you are notified once every 6 hours.
• Applied - Just applying is not enough, you might also receive the later steps through email, but have forgotten to check it lately. So for this you are notified once every 15 days.
• Applied with referral - Its much more safe if you apply with referral, so you are notified once every 30 days.
• Accepted - If your job application got accepted.
• Rejected - If your job application was turned down.

And not just this, the app is a package to provide you complete assistance through out. When asking for referrals you send the same text to many contacts, and want to keep that draft message safe with yourself. Applications Tracker lets you save this detail, and you can send the messages through LinkedIn, Whatsapp, etc. just with a click.

And above all, we respect your data privacy and all this data is saved only in your device and is never shared (But that also means, deleting app data will result in you loosing all the information).

Managing, assisting and organizing your job search, is what we do. To know more, visit https://github.com/kartik-pant-23/applications-tracker/#features

name: WorkingHours Time Tracker
description:
Track work hours without turning your day into admin work. WorkingHours is a time tracker, timesheet and personal work log for freelancers, hourly workers, employees, contractors and consultants who need clear records of time, earnings and billable hours.

Start a work timer, pause for breaks, stop when you are done, or add and edit entries manually. Organize hours by project, task, tag, note and hourly rate so your timesheet is ready when you need to review, export or invoice it.

What you can do with WorkingHours
• Track work time with start, pause and stop timer controls
• Pause and resume breaks, or subtract breaks automatically
• Add, edit and correct manual time entries anytime
• Automatically split work sessions that run across midnight
• Use it as a work hours tracker, work log or time sheet
• Organize entries by tasks, projects, tags and notes
• Track billable hours, hourly rates, fixed fees and earnings
• Keep overtime records for extra hours worked
• Adjust time or earnings with tag rules when needed
• Filter and search entries by task, tag or date
• View charts for time, revenue and productivity patterns
• Export timesheets to Excel or CSV
• Customize export columns and group by day, week, month, task or tag
• Create PDF invoices from tracked time via SubTotal
• Import appointments from your system or Outlook calendar
• Use Pomodoro focus sessions when you want a productivity timer
• Sync across devices with your own cloud storage, if you choose

Built for personal time tracking
WorkingHours works as a freelance time tracker, project time tracker, task timer, invoice time tracker, hours worked calculator, shift tracker or simple time clock for your own workday. It helps you record when you worked, what you worked on and how much time or money each entry represents.

Use the timer like a punch clock, then review totals like a time card calculator when it is time to check hours, overtime, billable work or project costs.

Android tools for faster tracking
Start and manage your timer from widgets and notifications, use geofencing to start or stop tracking when you arrive at or leave a workplace, and control the timer with NFC tags where supported.

Reports, exports and billing support
Review your work log in clear charts, switch reports between duration and revenue, and filter entries to understand where your time goes. Export your timesheet to Excel or CSV, choose the columns you need, and group entries by day, week, month, task or tag. When you need invoices, SubTotal can create PDF invoices from your WorkingHours data.

Your data, your choice
No WorkingHours account or registration is required for the app itself. Optional sync uses your own cloud storage, including OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud or WebDAV, so you can keep your work log available across supported Android, Windows, iOS and macOS versions.

That means you can track time on your phone or tablet, then continue reviewing or editing your timesheet on a laptop or desktop through the app's sync model.

Free to use, optional Pro
WorkingHours is free to use. Some advanced features require WorkingHours Pro, which can be tested with a 7-day trial after installing the app.

On Android, Pro removes ads and includes advanced features such as cloud sync, Excel/CSV export, focus sessions, unlimited tasks, widget and notification timer control, and geofencing. Pro is available as either a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription with the same features.

Your Android Pro purchase or subscription is linked to your Google Play account and unlocks Pro for the Android version. Other platforms may require a separate purchase.

name: Toggl Track - Time Tracking
description:
Toggl Track is a simple but mighty time tracker that shows you how much your time is worth. Filling timesheets has never been this easy — start tracking your hours with just one tap. Export tracking data with ease.

You can track time by projects, clients, or tasks and see how your workday breaks down into hours and minutes your reports. Find out what’s making you money, and what’s holding you back.

We also have you covered across all of your devices! Start tracking your hours in a browser, then stop it later on your phone. All of your tracked time is safely synced between your phone, desktop, web and a browser extension.

Our time-saving features:
◼ Reports
See how you spend your time with daily, weekly or monthly reports and graphs. Look them in the app or export them to send that data to your clients (or to analyze it further with through business intelligence and see to where your hours are going).

◼ Calendar
Toggl Track integrates with your Calendar! With this feature, you can now easily add your events from your calendar as time entries, through the Calendar View!

◼ Pomodoro Mode
Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique, thanks to our built-in Pomodoro mode.

The idea behind the Pomodoro technique is that you can work more effectively when you work in timed, 25-minute increments (with breaks in between). Our Pomodoro timer automatically tracks your time in 25-minute increments, with notifications, a full screen mode, and countdown timer to really help you stay focused and on task.

◼ Favorites
Favorites allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used time entries. Start tracking time on a favorite time entry with one tap.

◼ Notifications
Enable notifications so that you always know if & what are you tracking (or if you're not tracking anything!), and always be aware where does your time go.

◼ Customize your time entries with projects, clients and tags
Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients and tags. Clearly see where your work hours go and adjust your precious time & routines accordingly.

◼ Shortcuts
By using @ and #, you can quickly add those projects and tags much faster and get back to work right away!

◼ Widgets
Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

◼ Sync
Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

◼ Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

◽ But what if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

◽ Can I send you some feedback?
You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. Whether you are at an office, in commute, stuck on a space mission to Mars or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money - track your time anywhere you go!

📊 AUTOMATIC MILEAGE CALCULATIONS

LogBook calculates your claimable amount automatically using the mileage rates you enter. Supports tiered rate systems where the first portion of kilometres or miles is claimed at a higher rate and additional kilometres or miles at a lower rate. Update your rates each year when new ones are published — your historical trips keep their original rates. See your total business kilometres or miles, trip count, and claimable amount at a glance on your dashboard.

📄 PROFESSIONAL PDF & CSV REPORTS

Export a detailed mileage report as a PDF or CSV file and share it directly with your accountant. Reports include trip dates, routes, distances, purposes, vehicle details, and calculated claims. Choose your reporting period — current month, current year, full financial year, or a custom date range. Reports are generated entirely on your device and are ready for tax filing.

🚗 MULTIPLE VEHICLES

Track mileage across multiple vehicles, each with its own fuel type, mileage rate, and photo. Supports petrol, diesel, hybrid, and electric vehicles with separate rates for each. Set a primary vehicle for quick trip logging. Archive old vehicles while keeping their history intact.

🌍 BUILT FOR YOUR COUNTRY

LogBook is configured for New Zealand, Australia, United Kingdom, United States, and Canada. Each country has its own currency, distance unit, and financial year pre-configured. name: DriverLog Logbook
description:
DriverLog is the simplest to operate, most complete and most versatile electronic Hours Of Service solution.
DriverLog is both a mobile app that can be installed on any Android device, and is an integrated Fleet management application (can be integrated into 3rd party solutions or our Wireless Links Fleet.Net)

On the server side, DriverLog provides the dispatcher with complete visibility of the status of every driver in the HOS shift and cycle including replay of daily history and comprehensive reports.

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

This is a partial list of the DriverLog functionalities :
• Automatically calculates and displays current and available driving and on duty time in drivers’ shift and cycle.
• Allows review of six months of day-by-day history.
• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)
• Alerts the driver of upcoming shift and/or cycle time violations
• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.
• DriverLog has the option to send real time GPS data to a fleet management system, saving the need for a separate GPS unit

PrePass, trusted partner for weigh station bypass, toll management, and compliance solutions to more than 100,000 U.S. fleets representing more than 800,000 vehicles, is the most reliable, widely utilized weigh-station bypass system in North America. PrePass not only helps fleets save time, fuel, and money, but helps them gain greater efficiencies for shippers, and supports improved safety for all vehicles on the highway.

The PrePass Mobile App provides coverage for mobile weigh-station sites, and when used with a transponder, provides greater bypass reliability and integration with NORPASS and Oregon Green Light weigh station locations. Approximately two miles from a station, the mobile app notifies the driver whether they are cleared to bypass or must pull in. Pre-approved vehicles are electronically identified and weighed at highway speeds, receiving either a “bypass” or “pull in” alert. For those required to stop, detailed inspection data is made available through the INFORM™ Safety data platform, ensuring that compliance management remains data-driven and organized.

PrePass is an endorsed featured product of the American Trucking Associations (ATA) and is also endorsed by the Owner Operator Independent Drivers Association (OOIDA), Truckers Service Association (TSA), National Association of Small Trucking Companies (NASTC) and state trucking associations across the country.

• Most bypassing options with a mobile app and a transponder.

OFFLINE: The app works 100% offline — including search and navigation. You can explore the map and navigate without an internet connection, saving on mobile data and roaming fees. And with no background data transfers, your battery lasts much longer.

OPENSTREETMAP-BASED: OpenStreetMap is a wiki-style world map built and maintained by millions of volunteers — locals who know their areas best. This community effort results in highly detailed maps, often more accurate than commercial ones in less-mapped regions. Organic Maps updates its data from OpenStreetMap every two weeks, keeping your maps fresh and reliable. And if you notice something missing, you can add it to OpenStreetMap and help improve the map for everyone.

PRIVACY-FIRST: We don’t collect any data or identifiers. This means there’s no risk of data leaks and no distractions like ads or noisy notifications — just a clean, private map experience.

IMPORTANT FEATURES

EXPLORE PLACES: Search by address, name, or category, discover millions of POIs, and view detailed information such as opening hours, Wikipedia articles, wheelchair accessibility, and other helpful details.

GPS NAVIGATION: Enjoy voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions. Create walking, hiking, cycling, or driving routes — including routes between cities, countries, and multiple waypoints. Find the best routes for your metro journeys and commutes. Android Auto is supported.

HIKING & CYCLING TRAILS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Enable special map layers to discover popular hiking and cycling routes worldwide, all sourced from OpenStreetMap. Switch between layers to see colored bike and MTB routes, as well as official hiking paths.

PUBLIC TRANSPORT: See public transport route numbers at stops. Live transport schedules and routing are currently in development.

MAP STYLES: Choose map layers that fit your activity — Outdoors, Contour Lines, Hiking, Cycling, or Metro/Subway.

TRACK RECORDER: Record, import, export, and share your routes and favorite places. Supports KML, KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON formats.

WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES: Explore Wikipedia articles for places you discover on the map. Type “?wiki” in the search to find all places with Wikipedia articles.

MAP EDITOR: Contribute to OpenStreetMap by adding missing places or editing the map directly from Organic Maps.

DARK MODE: Switch to a dark theme for comfortable viewing at night.

Try the app — it’s 100% free, ad-free, fast, and fully offline. Experience reliable GPS navigation for hiking, biking, trekking, and travel anywhere in the world! Enjoy a fast, reliable, and private map experience, and share it with others!

Drive Hours is a clean and intuitive application created for learner drivers who want to track their driving lessons and monitor progress toward obtaining a driver’s license. Sessions can also be categorized by license type, making it easy to stay organized even when tracking multiple courses.

The app also estimates how many days remain until completion based on your activity, allowing you to plan your lessons more effectively and maintain steady progress.

To keep you motivated, Drive Hours includes an achievement system that rewards progress throughout your course. Milestones such as the first recorded hour, halfway completion, and final achievement help visualize success and encourage regular practice. Achievements are dynamically adapted to your selected license category, giving you a clear sense of advancement.

The design of Drive Hours emphasizes simplicity and modern usability. The interface follows Material Design principles, offering smooth animations, intuitive navigation, and an edge-to-edge layout for an immersive experience. The app supports light mode, dark mode, and system-based themes, ensuring comfortable use in any environment. Its responsive layout adapts well to different screen sizes while remaining easy to use.

The app automatically detects your system language, and you can also change the language manually in the settings at any time. This makes the application accessible to a broader range of users without additional configuration.

Drive Hours is designed for learner drivers preparing for their driving test, students tracking mandatory driving hours, instructors helping learners stay organized, and anyone who wants a clear overview of their driving practice. Unlike complicated tracking tools, Drive Hours focuses on clarity, elegance, and ease of use, making it effortless to log sessions and understand progress at a glance.

Getting started is simple. Choose your driving license category, set your required number of hours, and begin adding driving sessions. As you continue, you can watch your progress grow and unlock achievements along the way.

Whether you're arranging childcare, booking a vacation or coordinating plans with family and friends, you'll always know when you're available.

MyShiftPlanner was created with one simple goal: making shift work easier to manage.

name: ShiftMed - Nursing Jobs App
description:
Ready to slay your work schedule and live your best life? ShiftMed has the job flexibility you’ve been craving. Say goodbye to feeling overworked and undervalued. Because now you get to call the shifts while scoring the pay and perks you deserve.

Whether you’re a CNA, GNA, STNA, LVN, LPN, or RN, ShiftMed puts you in control, letting you work shifts at local healthcare facilities when, where, and how often you want.

With old-school scheduling headaches and mind-numbing staffing limitations no longer holding you back, the nursing world is yours to conquer. So, get out there and embrace the work-life balance that’s as fierce as you are!

Job Flexibility at Your Fingertips

Ready to shine bright and make your future spark? Whether you’re looking for per diem, short-term, long-term, or permanent work in the medical field, ShiftMed puts incredible power at your fingertips, letting you choose the shifts that fit your style, all while earning those dollar bills with a smile.

Through our app, you can easily access a variety of open shifts at various healthcare facilities in your community, from long-term care locations to nursing homes to hospitals. When building your work schedule precisely how you want it, our app has all the tools you need to succeed.

You can filter your shift feed based on your preferred start time, driving distance, hourly rate, and favorite healthcare facility. Talk about personalized perfection! We also don’t believe in shift minimums—work 8 hours one week and 40 the next. And unless you’re looking to make some sweet holiday pay, mandatory holidays, overtime, and weekends are no longer a thing.

Work Benefits You Deserve

As a ShiftMed nurse, you can access benefits that will make your heart sing and your career soar. We’ve got an entire lineup of perks that include competitive pay, holiday rates, bonus incentives, affordable healthcare plans, and exclusive in-app features.

· Guaranteed Shifts®: Get paid for the entire shift if the facility cancels or sends you home early. So, there’s no need to stack your schedule with overlapping shifts because you’re worried a facility might cancel—the only shift you need to claim is a guaranteed one.

· ShiftMed Instant Pay™: Request up to 75% of your pre-taxes earnings immediately after clocking out of a shift. Submit the desired amount, and we’ll deposit the funds directly into your bank account with ZERO transaction fees.

· Next Day Pay®: If your bank doesn’t support Instant Pay ACH transfers, you can still get paid before Friday using our free Next Day Pay service. Request to receive up to 75% of your pre-tax earnings, and we’ll deposit your pay directly into your bank account the next business day.

· Uber Health Rides: Never again will car problems slow you down. Our exclusive partnership with Uber Health allows you to request rides to and from your shifts directly in our app.

· Hooray Health: Access quality, affordable health insurance benefits for you and your family after working just one shift. Plan offerings include medical options, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance.

· Platinum Rewards Program: We reward you big time for showing up for shifts, from entry into monthly sweepstakes to first dibs on holiday pay rates. And the higher your show rate, the better your shift-claiming experience gets.

· W-2 Employment Status: When you work with ShiftMed, you’re a W-2 employee—not a 1099 independent contractor. Being a W-2 employee is loaded with benefits, such as paying less in FICA payroll taxes, being eligible for company benefits, and so much more!

Connect With Us

Learn more about working with us as a CNA, GNA, STNA, LVN, LPN, or RN by visiting ShiftMed.com or giving us a shout at (800) 485-9002. Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, and LinkedIn for our latest updates.

What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions

4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

name: flixGRADE the best teacher app
description:
FlixGRADE is the ultimate app for teachers to manage participation grades. It offers comprehensive support for classroom management, focusing on recognizing and documenting student participation. This goal is enhanced by a functional seating chart with versatile input and display options. FlixGRADE stands out for its user-friendly interface, clear presentation, extensive range of features, and flexible configuration options.

Easy to use:

- Ideal for smartphones and tablets
- No tedious scheduling of lessons
- Uncomplicated entry of student data and grades
FlixGRADE simplifies the daily teaching routine: Open a class, enter student information, and the lesson begins. All data is saved with the current date. Participation grades can be entered directly without prior setup. Other student achievements, such as vocabulary tests, can be defined once and used multiple times for grade entries.

Clear presentation:

- All entries for a day at a glance
- Seating plan for more overview
- Current grade status and number of evaluations
- Inclusively educated students
- All active checklists with processing status
- Entries and remarks about the student in the previous lesson
All entries start with the student, whether in the seating plan or the student list, and are displayed on one screen for the current day. The next day, the entries can be found on the detail pages of the students. The student list and seating plan are then free of entries again, making it easier for the teacher to track which evaluations were entered for that day.

Extensive features:

- Multiple selection and batch entries for efficient work
- Group assistant and random generator
- Participation trend through visual regression line
- Flexible, freely definable grading systems
- Calculation of grade suggestions
- Coursebook for documenting the course of the lesson
- Integration of pictures of classes, students, and learning products
Entries can be made for multiple students simultaneously, and serial entry enables a quick, systematic assessment of the participation. The group assistant makes it easier to form groups with homogeneous performance.

New data protection concept:

- Minimal data framework
- Encrypted data
- No central server
- Automatic deletion
- Grade export via email
The FlixGRADE teacher app offers a comprehensive data protection concept in accordance with the GDPR. Student data remains on the mobile device and is encrypted. Student data is not transmitted to a central server. FlixGRADE restricts itself to the most essential data and uses neutral descriptions. The grades and the number of assessments and days of absence can be saved via email export. All entries for a student are automatically deleted after a defined period.

Free for up to 4 learning groups and 80 students. After that, the app can be unlocked for unlimited students and classes through an in-app purchase (approximately €1 per month).

FlixGRADE, the teacher app for an efficient day in the classroom, offers far more possibilities than a conventional teacher calendar or planner. Check it out and make your teaching easier!

Best regards,
Stefan Heizmann
Mitarbeitsapp GmbH

REMINDERS

Includes four colour vision deficiency modes, high contrast mode, reduced motion, text scaling from 0.5× to 2.0×, and 18 colour themes.

UNIVERSITY & HIGH SCHOOL MODES
Terminology adapts throughout the student planner between Semester/Course (university) and Term/Subject (high school) conventions.

All data is stored locally with encrypted storage. Cloud backup and sync available optionally for users who create an account.

It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

description:
Photo Finish introduces an innovative automatic timing system designed to precisely measure athletic performance across a range of sports including track and field, soccer, American football, basketball, cycling, and many more!

Dive into the history section to see your data come to life. Export your results in CSV format to uncover trends, highlight consistent improvements, or spot areas of stagnation. Use these insights to fine-tune your workouts, whether you're aiming to boost speed, enhance endurance, or perfect your technique.

Besides functioning as a sprint timer, the app also allows you to time your agility drills across various sports, such as American football, soccer, basketball, and more. Imagine polishing your technique under time pressure, building greater confidence in your abilities.
Coaches can add the participating athletes in the automatic series mode. Once set, there's no need to interact with the phones during training. Voice commands announce the next athlete, and all performances are recorded hands-free!

Photo Finish is designed for user-friendliness and effortless setup. Devices connect and synchronize via Bluetooth and subsequently share their timing data over the internet, ensuring limitless transmission range.

We know you'll do anything to reach your peak performance. That's why we prioritize reliability and continuous updates to ensure our app always delivers.

name: Golden Hour: Retro Film Camera
description:
Turn your phone into a real film camera. Golden Hour is a vintage camera app that brings back the soul of analog photography — authentic film grain, dreamy light leaks, warm tones, and that one-of-a-kind golden hour glow that only film can capture.

Shoot every moment like it's the last frame on the roll. No edits needed. No filters that feel fake. Just real, beautiful film photos — straight from the shutter.

✨ AUTHENTIC FILM LOOK
Every shot is processed through a real film simulation engine that recreates the grain, tones, and color science of classic 35mm film stocks. Not a preset slapped on top — a true film camera experience built from the ground up.

📸 RETRO & VINTAGE CAMERAS
Choose from a curated collection of retro cameras — disposable camera, 35mm film camera, instant camera, CCD digital camera, and more. Each camera has its own personality, color palette, and character. Switch between them with one tap.

🎞 REAL FILM GRAIN & TEXTURES
Film grain isn't a Gaussian blur on top of your photo. It's stochastic texture mapped to your sensor data, giving you the same beautiful imperfection you'd get from a real film roll. Plus dust, scratches, and halation for that fully analog camera feel.

🌅 GOLDEN HOUR LIGHTING
A signature Golden Hour mode tuned for warm, cinematic light — perfect for portraits, sunsets, street photography, and travel shots. Every photo looks like it was taken at magic hour.

💡 LIGHT LEAKS & LENS FLARES
Hand-crafted light leaks, lens flares, and color bleed effects that mimic the imperfections of vintage film cameras. Subtle, beautiful, never overdone.

🖼 POLAROID FRAMES & INSTANT CAMERA LOOK
Built-in polaroid camera frames and instant camera styles. Print-ready square crops with classic white borders, perfect for sharing on Instagram, scrapbooking, or printing as keepsakes.

📅 VINTAGE DATE STAMPS
Add classic film date stamps in the bottom corner — just like the old disposable cameras and family albums. Multiple date stamp fonts and styles available.

🎨 PROFESSIONAL FILM PRESETS
A library of carefully tuned film presets inspired by classic film stocks. Warm, cool, faded, high-contrast, pastel — find your signature look in seconds. Save your own custom presets too.

📱 SHOOT, DON'T EDIT
Golden Hour applies the film look in real time as you shoot — what you see is exactly what you get. No long export waits, no post-processing required. Capture and share instantly.

🌍 SHARE EVERYWHERE
One-tap share to Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Snapchat, and more. Photos save to your gallery in full resolution so you can print them, frame them, or upload them anywhere.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE GOLDEN HOUR

• Real-time film effects — no waiting for renders
• Multiple retro camera styles to fit every mood
• Designed for both photographers and casual creators
• No watermarks on your photos
• Lightweight, fast, and easy to use
• Built with love by a small indie team

PERFECT FOR

📷 Film photography lovers who miss the look of analog
🎨 Creators who want their feed to stand out with a vintage aesthetic
👫 Friends capturing memories that feel timeless
✈ Travelers shooting golden hour landscapes and street scenes
💍 Couples and families building photo albums with character
🌆 Anyone tired of phone photos that look too clean and digital

JOIN THE FILM REVIVAL

Film photography is back. Golden Hour brings the soul of analog cameras — the warmth, the grain, the imperfect beauty — to your phone, without the cost of buying real film or developing rolls. Every shot tells a story. Every photo feels like a memory.

Download Golden Hour now and start shooting your life on film.

name: Shot Designer
description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

ADVICE:
Try to memorize the track’s chords and study the pentatonic & other scales diagrams closely. Each key has less than 10 boxes! They are not really hard to remember! Finally, you should learn where each box starts for each key. In the end, you will be jamming along with any track effortlessly! More than 700 jam tracks for guitar are at your disposal!

CREATED BY GUITARISTS, FOR GUITARISTS
Practice makes perfect. Backing Tracks Guitar Jam offers an easy-to-use tool to help musicians of all levels master their art. It simulates a real-sounding band that can accompany you as you practice.
This app used by many music students, teachers and some of the world’s top music schools such as Berklee College of Music and Musicians Institute.

BUILD CONFIDENCE
Practicing your scales is the best way to get comfortable with the fretboard. Once your learn the at least 5 different shapes of the pentatonic scale in every key, you'll be able to play along and solo to nearly any song!

IT'S SO EASY TO USE
We created the simplest, fastest and most enjoyable way to practice guitar on a mobile device. Just tap a key and hit play!

FEATURES
☆ About 740 jam tracks in the constantly updating library. More than 400 of them are free!
☆ More than 30 music styles and genres to satisfy any taste: rock, hard rock, blues, jazz, metal, pop, country, soul, funk, acoustic, Indie rock punk rock, reggae, etc.
☆ Tempo change function.
☆ Key change function.
☆ Metronome.
☆ Recording yourself playing & singing along with the accompaniment.
☆ Scale library. Access to 2000+ guitar scales.
☆ Chord library. Access to 5000+ guitar chords.
☆ No more low-quality MIDI playback: app gives you access to more than 740 high-quality backing tracks to accompany you.
☆ A variety of playlist sorting and filtration options.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Select a backing track (choose from the included 30 different accompaniment styles)
2. Adjust tempo and key.
3. Improve your skills by using Chords tab to view the chords used in the track and view the scale diagrams for solo and improvisation.
4. Jam on guitar and make practice fun! Focus on guitar techniques with collections of music from professional guitarists.

FOR RHYTHM AND LEAD PLAYERS
Every track has a listing of chords that are used in the track, along with scale charts - practice rhythm or lead with ease!

WHAT IS A PENTATONIC SCALE?
A pentatonic scale is one consisting of five notes, and that’s it! It is used widely in all genres and styles, and it is one of the most important scales for guitarists.
There are many forms & templates (boxes) for each key. The boxes remain unchanged, except starting positions are different.
Therefore, once you grasp one key, other ones will come much easier!

We strive for excellence, and we're always eager to improve your Guitar Jam experience!
Let us help you in person - contact developer at smakarovpro@gmail.com, and we'll do our best to meet your requests.

name: BAND for Kids
description:
BAND for Kids is a group communication app designed for youth (ages 12 and under) to stay connected with their families, sports teams, scout troops, and more. BAND for Kids is a safe space for adolescents to interact within a private social platform, while allowing parents and guardians to moderate activity.

◆ Easy to get started:
- Kids can get started by following these three steps:
1) Download BAND for Kids app to a mobile phone or tablet.
2) Use an email address to sign up (parent consent is required).
3) Join a private Band by parents or guardian invitation.

◆ How parents and kids communicate together safely:
- Kids cannot join groups they were NOT invited to.
- Parents can monitor which group their kids have joined.
- Parents can follow their children’s BAND activity by also joining their groups.

◆ Safer environment for kids to communicate:
- No harassment from strangers.
- No advertisements and in-app purchases.
- Kids cannot create or invite themselves to Bands/Pages.
- Kids cannot search or join public Bands.

◆ Available features for kids:
- Admin of the Band can determine which features are available to the Kids users.
- With BAND for Kids, adolescent users can publish posts on the Community Board and attach files, images, or videos to the posts. They can also chat with other members of their Bands.

◆ Accessibility:
- BAND for Kids is available on any device including smart phones, tablets, and PC.

◆ Private and Secure
- BAND has acquired the SOC 2 and 3 certificates for its privacy protection and ISO/IEC27001 Certification for outstanding information security management systems.

◆ Group Video & Voice Calls:

Kids can join group video or voice calls with other Band members.
Calls are only available when enabled by the Band admin.
Up to 30 participants can join a call at once.
Calls are limited to invited members only, keeping kids safe from contact with strangers.
Admins can manage calls with muting controls to maintain a safe environment.

name: Complete Music Reading Trainer
description:
The ultimate music reading training app. Designed like a video game and with strong pedagogical concepts in mind, Complete Music Reading Trainer is the fastest way to learn to read sheet music and improve your sight-reading skills. Whichever clef you want to learn and whatever your instrument is, the app will make you master any chosen clef or clef combination while rendering the learning process enjoyable.


Features

• 270 progressive drills covering all seven clefs (treble, bass, alto, tenor, soprano, mezzo-soprano and baritone clefs) over 3 levels / 26 chapters
• Content is organized in such a way that you can choose which levels or chapters are relevant to your instrument and focus on these, whether you play the guitar and only need treble clef, piano and need treble and bass clef, cello and need a mix of bass and tenor clefs, etc.: all instruments are covered
• Practice key signatures up to 6 sharps/flats in progressive key signature drills
• Practice common clef combinations in mixed clef drills
• Play a selection of 19 drills in arcade mode
• 5 octaves of actual recorded grand piano sounds
• 6 additional sound banks are available, all with actual recorded sounds: vintage piano, Rhodes piano, electric guitar, harpsichord, concert harp and pizzicato strings
• 4 ways to input notes: note circle, virtual piano keyboard, by connecting a MIDI controller, or by playing an instrument near your device's microphone
• 4 sheet music display styles: modern, classic, handwritten and jazz
• Designed like a video game: earn 3 stars in each drill of a chapter to complete it. Or will you be able to obtain perfect 5-star scores?
• Don't want to follow the preestablished path of progression? Create and save your own custom drills and rehearse them at your own convenience
• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards
• Never lose any progress: cloud sync across your various devices
• Google Play Games: 35 achievements to unlock
• Google Play Games: leaderboards to compare arcade mode scores with other players worldwide
• Global statistics to track your progress
• Nice and clean material design user interface with 2 display themes: light and dark
• Designed by a musician and music teacher with a Royal Conservatory master's degree


Full Version

• Download the app and try out the first chapter of each clef for free
• One-time in-app purchase of $4.99 to unlock the full version on all your Android devices


Having a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at hello@completemusicreadingtrainer.com

name: Breastfeeding Newborn tracker
description:
The simplest program to track breastfeeding, pumping, bottle feeding, solid food consumption, diapers, sleep schedule, height and weight, and more.

In the application, you can share baby's data with your partner, relatives, or nanny. Syncing data between multiple devices is available for free.

The birth of a baby is a miracle that fills your heart with joy! A mother’s life changes dramatically with the birth of her baby. It is so important for a mother and her newborn baby to establish a comfortable breastfeeding relationship. Moms need to keep track of which breast to offer her baby, how long the baby suckles at each breast, the number of times the baby breastfeeds each day, how many wet diapers and bowel movements the baby has, how long and frequently the baby sleeps, as well as the baby’s weight and growth. All of this information is important for the self-assessment of breastfeeding and for assessing the growth of the child. Having this information easily accessible will be extremely useful when visiting with your pediatrician or lactation consultant.

It is important to record all of this data. Do not rely on your memory, because even the most organized mothers are often lost in the sea of information about their newborn.

Use the features of the Breastfeeding application.

Breastfeeding and pumping:
- record the time and quantity of feedings and / or pumpings;
- note which breast was fed or pumped last to ensure starting new feeding/pumping on the opposite breast;
- record the duration of feeding / pumping;
- pause feeding / pumping, if necessary;
- brief feedings / pumpings, or those that occur within a short period of time, are grouped into one feeding / pumping event
- quickly add feeding / pumping session that was similar to the most recent but update with current time
- use the maximum duration of feeding setting and the application will stop recording the feeding / pumping at the set time if you are unable to press stop

Liquids:
- consider all of your child’s fluid intake (water, expressed breast milk, formula, juice, etc.);
-track your child’s reactions to new fluids and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers;
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Feeding (solid food):
- add solid foods as your child begins eating them (cereal, vegetables, fruits, meat, fish);
- track your child’s reactions to these new foods and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Sleep:
- record the time and duration of your baby’s sleep each day so you can better plan your day;
- compare your baby’s sleep habits with recommended sleep guidelines


Diapers:
- track the number of your baby’s wet and / or dirty diapers. This information is crucial for noticing signs of dehydration, constipation, and diarrhea and alerting the child’s pediatrician if necessary.

Measurements:
- track height and weight to evaluate your baby’s development;

Other features:
- edit or delete events as needed;
- set reminders for various events;
- use the application in your native language (more than 40 languages available);
- select your preferred units of measurement (ounces or milliliters);
- browse graphs;
- view statistics;
- enter data for several children and twins;
- backup all of your data;
and more!

PRO-version
- disable advertising;
- install widgets for quick viewing and launch;
- auto backup every 24 hours;
- export to Excel


We are constantly working to improve the application. Write to us with questions and suggestions.

Enjoy watching your healthy baby grow!

name: plop - poop tracker & analyzer
description:
Plop is an advanced poop tracker and gut health analytics app designed for individuals managing IBS, IBD, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis, and chronic diarrhea. When users ask about poop shapes or irregular bowel movements, Plop provides the data-driven insights needed to discuss gut health with a gastroenterologist.

Plop helps you understand your digestive health through intelligent pattern recognition and personalized insights. By combining easy daily logging with advanced health analysis, Plop empowers you to identify what affects your gut and make informed decisions about your wellness.

Discover Your Unique Patterns
Pattern recognition is the core of the Plop experience. The app analyzes your data to reveal insights that are difficult to see on your own:
* Personal Baseline:
Plop establishes your individual normal from your logging history. The app learns what is typical for your body and alerts you to meaningful deviations.
* Visual Trend Analysis:
Spot rhythms in your health with over 10 interactive charts. These visuals make it easy to see if your bowel movements shift with your lifestyle habits or follow a weekly pattern.
* ML-Driven Alerts:
Receive automatic notifications when ML-driven analytics detect significant changes in your frequency or consistency.
* Factor Correlations:
See how specific triggers like stress, diet, medications or sleep actually impact your digestion through visual correlation analysis.


Effortless, Quick-Tap Logging
Consistency is the most important part of health tracking, so Plop makes it fast and friction-free:
* Rapid Entry:
Log a new entry in seconds by selecting the date, time, and Bristol Scale shape classification, alongside basic symptoms and stool conditions.
* Fully Customizable:
Create unique factors based on your doctor’s advice or specific health conditions to monitor what matters most to your personal journey.
* Optional Depth:
Add photos, notes, or create more factor tags when you want to dive deeper into your documentation.
* Flexible History:
Review your history in a calendar or list view and easily edit past entries if you make a mistake.


Doctor-Ready Reports
Plop bridges the gap between personal tracking and medical care by generating reports that healthcare providers understand:
* Monthly Report:
The app synthesizes your data into reports that summarize your regularity and trends.
* Shareable Data:
Export your insights as professional PDF or CSV files to share with your gastroenterologist during your next appointment.


Your Privacy, Your Control
Your health information is personal and sensitive, which is why Plop uses a local-first architecture:
* On-Device Storage:
Your data lives on your device by default and the app works fully offline.
* Optional Cloud Sync:
You decide whether to enable cloud backup or sync across multiple devices.
* No Data Selling:
Your health insights remain yours alone, giving you complete control over your sensitive information.


Who is Plop For?
Plop is designed for anyone looking to see their gut health more clearly, including:
* Individuals managing chronic conditions like IBS, Crohn’s, or Ulcerative Colitis.
* People identifying food sensitivities or tracking an elimination diet.
* Health-conscious users who want to understand how lifestyle factors like stress and exercise affect their body.

Download Plop today to start exploring your health patterns. The core experience is free for everyone, with premium options available for those who want deeper correlation analysis and advanced pattern detection.


Medical Disclaimer
Plop is a personal tracking and wellness tool, not a medical device. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease. ML-driven insights and alerts are for informational purposes to support—not replace—professional medical advice. Always consult your doctor or gastroenterologist regarding your digestive health. Use is at your own risk.

This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

This senior safety app uses phone/tablet sensors and home IoT sensors to monitor and detect problems. It alerts family and caregivers in the care-group. Great for senior safety. A Panic button (SOS app) works 24/7 indoors and outdoors. The GPS tracker with geo-fencing can tell you when a loved one leaves home and when they arrive back.

[3] Daily senior living
This senior citizen app allows a senior to be socially engaged, contribute to family or community, continue with activities that give life meaning, and to maintain choice and control. Automatic sensor notifications help a person to feel connected and involved with their family.

[4] Senior care app
A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

PRIVACY
This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. Bladder diaries are often part of clinical bladder care, but paper logs are difficult to keep up with in daily life. Entries are frequently missed, estimated, or incomplete, limiting how useful they can be over time.

In clinical bladder care, bladder diaries are widely used because they provide structured, time-based records that help clinicians understand patterns over time. When completed consistently, diaries can support more informed discussions and better decision-making during care.

Bladderly was built to help bridge this gap between clinical guidance and real-world use.

■ Designed for real-world compliance

- Replace paper bladder diaries with a simple digital experience
- Reduce missed or incomplete entries during busy daily routines
- Make it easier to log consistently over days and weeks

Bladderly fits naturally into everyday life, helping turn bathroom routines into structured records - without adding friction.

■ How Bladderly works

- Log bathroom visits and timing with minimal effort
- Supports manual entry and offers optional sound-assisted logging to help estimate voided volume
- Organizes entries into clear, easy-to-review records
- Designed for privacy and discreet daily use

Bladderly works whether you prefer simple manual tracking or more automated logging.

■ Built for patterns, not pressure

Consistent diaries make it easier to notice habits, timing, and patterns that are hard to recall from memory alone. Bladderly focuses on helping users complete bladder diaries more reliably - creating a stronger foundation for future conversations and insights.

■ Trusted by thousands

Over 7,800 users have recorded more than 63,000 days of bladder diaries with Bladderly, demonstrating strong real-world adherence in a category where compliance is often challenging.

■ Looking ahead

Structured, consistent diary data opens the door to deeper understanding over time. While Bladderly currently focuses on tracking and record-keeping, future features may explore educational and supportive insights based on diary patterns.

Bladderly is designed to support tracking and record-keeping, not diagnosis or treatment. It helps bring clarity and structure to bladder diaries - on your terms, in everyday life.

PET CARE IS MESSY:

PREMIUM:

PRIVACY:

name: Pillbug: the fun meds reminder
description:
Pillbug is a helpful little bug obsessed with one thing: making sure you take your meds and supplements on time, and actually ENJOY taking care of your health. Whether you’re managing ADHD medication, antidepressants, birth control pills or anything else, Pillbug makes staying consistent simple, private, and rewarding.

Medications are a clinical issue, but we think medication apps should not FEEL clinical, they should be fun to use. That's where Pillbug comes in.

Reliable reminders you’ll actually respond to!
Pillbug keeps you on schedule with gentle, caring reminders.
He highly recommends installing his widget so you never forget a dose. That way he’ll even tuck you into bed when you’ve had a good medication day (he’s very proud of you!)

Say goodbye to “Wait… did I take it?”
We’ve all had that stressful moment: Did you take your medication today? Should you take it now? Did you maybe already take it? You don’t want to skip it. You don’t want to double-dose. What do you do?

Pillbug fixes that!
See, logging your meds is crucial to understanding your health, but most people forget to log, or they log first and get distracted before taking their dose. Then logs become unreliable.
Pillbug’s patent-pending Scan to Log feature changes everything. Just scan any label - your bottle, pillbox, right as you take your medication.
Because if you’re right next to your meds when you log them, you’ll actually take them.
And you can trust your log completely.
Pillbug will even warn you if you’re about to take the wrong pill. He’s responsible like that.
Optional, but once you try it, you’ll never understand how you managed without it.

Don’t worry you can still log through notifications or through the app if you forget to scan.

Shared medication management (optional)
With Pillbug, medication management becomes collaborative. Perfect for families with teens or young adults, or for partners supporting each other.
More effective management without the nagging.

Privacy first
Your health data stays securely on your device. It’s never uploaded, shared, or accessible to anyone - not even us.

Perfect for
• Students juggling classes, internships, and a busy life
• Young professionals with packed schedules
• Anyone who wants to take their meds reliably, safely, and playfully
• People who want a medication habit that finally sticks

Download Pillbug now
Build a routine you can trust.
Never forget a dose again.
And do it with a tiny friend cheering you on.

Medical Disclaimer
Pillbug does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your physician or qualified health provider with any questions about your medications or health conditions.

name: The Log: Potty Training + EC
description:
Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Whether you are potty training your toddler or doing elimination communication (EC or infant potty training) with your 0-18 month baby, you need this app!

Observation time is key for knowing your little one’s natural timing intervals (how often s/he goes potty) and keeping track of any baby signals (or “peepee dances”) you see.

But forget that printable log you got from my website! You can now digitally track how often your baby pees or poops during observation time, or potty training, with ease.

If you’ve wondered:

“How often does my baby pee or poop?”

“When should I offer the potty to my little one?”

“If I want to set a potty time reminder on my phone, how long should I set it for?”

…The Log is your answer.

No more paper printouts and chicken-scratch logging, no more guessing “how often does my little actually pee or poop?”…now you can simply open the app and, starting at either waking or feeding, track how often your baby or toddler goes. Then download a PDF of your results.

*You can also take a note of your little one’s signals or other observations by long-pressing the activity button, as you go.

After starting potty training, or if you’re doing EC…after a few hours of observation time (or a few days if you’re really inquisitive)…visit the Reports screen to easily see your baby’s intervals in graph or written format.

Set a potty time alarm based on your baby’s actual timing intervals, so your smart phone can remind you throughout the day when to offer a “pottytunity” - or chance to go potty.

If you have a toddler you’re potty training or wrapping up EC with, you can use this app to set an alarm based on your observations - welcome to your new potty training alarm app!

Track one or more babies, keep the logs separate, and easily re-set the data to start a new observation sesh any time (I recommend you re-log your child’s rhythms every few months or so to keep it fresh!).

Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Developed by me, Andrea Olson, author of Go Diaper Free and The Tiny Potty Training Book, whose 5 children were all out of diapers by walking, none requiring potty trained…a mom who has hardly had to change a poopy diaper and has saved over $10,000 in diapers across their babyhoods…you’re in good hands when it comes to observing your baby for elimination communication. Learn more at godiaperfree.com or via the app, itself.

PS - if you’re stinking at potty training, learn more with the free classes inside the app. If you don’t know what EC is, it’s the natural alternative to diaper dependence and potty training, and it starts as early as birth to 18 months. It’s what people have done for all of human history, long before diapers were invented. We also have a free class and books on that.

That’s why we built Poopi—to help pet parents everywhere support their furry friends’ health, just as we did for Jack.

Our app is designed to help you identify irregularities, spot possible triggers, and share this information with your vet for better care. Whether you’re new to pet ownership or an experienced caregiver, Poopi offers meaningful insights that can significantly improve your pet’s quality of life. Equipped with monthly overviews and in-depth stats, you’ll have the tools to track your pet’s health trends and discuss any concerns or changes more effectively at every vet visit.

Take control of your pet’s digestive health today with Poopi, inspired by Jack and made for all pet parents!

* Poop Tracking: Log your dog's bowel movements quickly and easily to track date, time, and type—just like we did for Jack!
* Health Indicators: Monitor poop consistency, color, and frequency to detect potential health issues early on.
* Detailed Stats: Key stats to share with your veterinarian for improved diagnostic accuracy.
* Multi-Pet Support: Have multiple dogs or pets? Track each pet’s health individually with ease.
* Family & Friends Access: Share your pet’s profile with family members or friends and work together to maintain logs.
* User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive design for effortless tracking  

Why Track Your Dog’s Poop?  For pets like Jack, regular monitoring of bowel movements can reveal early signs of health problems such as digestive issues, infections, parasites, and dietary intolerances. Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.

name: MyRadar Weather Radar
description:
MyRadar is a fast, easy-to-use, yet powerful weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location, allowing you to quickly see what weather is coming your way. Just start the app, and your location pops up with animated live radar, with radar loop lengths of up to two hours. This basic functionality provides the quickest way to get a fast snapshot of the weather on-the-go, and it's what has made MyRadar so successful over the years. Check your phone and get an instant assessment of the weather that will impact your day.

In addition to the live radar, MyRadar has an ever-increasing list of weather and environmentally-related data layers that you can overlay on top of the map; our animated winds layer shows a breathtaking visual representation of both surface winds and winds at the jetstream level; the frontal boundaries layer shows high and low pressure systems as well as frontal boundaries themselves; the earthquakes layer is a great way to stay on top of the latest reports on seismic activity, completely customizable as to severity and time; our hurricane layer allows users to stay on top of the latest tropical storm and hurricane activity throughout the world; the aviation layer overlays AIRMETs, SIGMETs and other aviation-related data, including the ability to track flights and display their IFR flight plans and paths, and the "wildfires" layer allows users to stay abreast of the latest fire activity around the United States.

In addition to the data layers, MyRadar has the ability to send weather and environmental alerts, including alerts from the National Weather Center, such as Tornado and Severe Weather alerts. MyRadar includes the ability to receive alerts based off of Tropical Storm and Hurricane activity; you can configure the app to send you an alert any time a tropical storm or hurricane forms, or is upgraded or downgraded.

One of the most useful features in MyRadar is the ability to provide advanced rain alerts; our patent-pending process for predicting hyper-local rainfall is the most accurate in the industry. Instead of having to constantly check the app, MyRadar will send you an alert up to an hour in advance as to when the rain will arrive at your current location, down to the minute, including details on intensity and duration. These alerts can be a life saver when you're on-the-go and don't always have time to check the weather - our systems will proactively do the work for you and let you know in advance before the rain hits.

All of the weather and environmental data represented on MyRadar is displayed on our custom mapping system, developed in-house. This mapping system uses your devices GPU, which makes it incredibly fast and speedy. The map has the standard pinch/zoom capability which allows you to smoothly zoom and pan around the United States and the rest of the world to see what the weather is like anywhere on the planet.

In addition to the free features of the app, the premium upgrade is available, including real-time hurricane tracking - great for the start of hurricane season. This feature provides additional data above and beyond the free version, including the cone of probability for tropical storm/hurricane forecast tracks, and also includes a detailed synopsis from the National Hurricane Center. The premium upgrade also include the professional radar pack, which allows greater detail of radar from individual stations. Users can select individual radar stations around the US, select the radar tilt angle, and also change the radar product being displayed, including base reflectivity and wind velocity - great for experienced weather buffs looks to stay on top of possible tornado formation.

MyRadar is also available for Wear OS devices, including tiles for both radar and current conditions - try on your smartwatch!

Don't get caught off guard with bad weather; download MyRadar today and try it out!

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.
